intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Sant-Julien-des-Landes - Rue de Jau

intermediate.name: 1st passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (104.8 km)

story: Four riders formed the early breakaway, but two dropped back after the first passage of the finish line. The remaining duo stayed clear until 16 kilometres to go before being caught. It ended in a bunch sprint, where Vernon claimed his second consecutive stage victory.
